metadata.name: UpdatePortfolioID
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to update Portfolio ID of an account.

request_fields.name: PortfolioID
request_fields.description: Collateral ID to track legal receivable ownership of the Account. Valid Values: Valid Collateral ID return as a list in 'PortfolioID' via GetPortfolioIDMapping API. Example: Midland Condition: 1.This should be optional when Lender Assignment is set as 'Collateral and Portfolio ID'. 2.This ID must be amongst the ID existing for the Institution(List received in Response of GetPortfolioIDMapping API) Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.description: This Tag reflects the Application Version. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:2.0 Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: PlanSegmentID
request_fields.description: Description: Indicates the unique ID generated for each plan segment added to an account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:98756775 Condition: The tag will be mandatory only when the portfolio assignment on product is 'Plan'.

request_fields.name: AccountOwnerCollateralID
request_fields.description: Collateral ID to track legal ownership of  the Account separately from receivable ownership at Portfolio ID. Valid Values: Valid Collateral ID from the list of 'AccountCollateralID' return via GetPortfolioIDMapping API. Example: Midland Condition: This field is an Optional Tag and can setup only when Lender Assignment' is set as 'Collateral and Portfolio ID' on Program. Allowable Values: 50
